info.title: Stackiq
info.description: The JSON API of Stackiq, the software and application catalogue for Nextcloud: organisations, applications, components, contracts and their relations, the CMDB import, the service desk exchange, settings and the setup wizard. The catalogue objects themselves are stored in OpenRegister and read and written through its API; this document covers the endpoints Stackiq adds on top.

get.summary: Get all aanbod objects (modules, diensten, koppelingen, gebruiks)
get.description: Get all aanbod objects (modules, diensten, koppelingen, gebruiks).  API Endpoint: GET /api/aanbod  Returns modules, diensten, and koppelingen where the current organisation is in the aanbieder property, or gebruiks where the current organisation is in the afnemer property. Excludes objects where @self.organisation equals the current organisation.  Query Parameters: - limit (int): Maximum number of results to return - offset (int): Number of results to skip for pagination - page (int): Page number for pagination

200.description: JSON response with aanbod objects array

put.summary: Accept an aanbod object (set @self.organisation to current organisation)
put.description: Accept an aanbod object (set @self.organisation to current organisation).  API Endpoint: PUT /api/aanbod/{uuid}/accept  Sets the '@self.organisation' property of an aanbod object to the active organization. This operation is only allowed if the active organization is the afnemer (for gebruiks) or aanbieder (for modules, diensten, koppelingen).

200.description: JSON response with success status and updated object

delete.description: Deny an aanbod object (delete it).  API Endpoint: DELETE /api/aanbod/{uuid}/deny  Deletes an aanbod object. This operation is only allowed if the active organization is the afnemer (for gebruiks) or aanbieder (for modules, diensten, koppelingen).

200.description: JSON response with success status and deletion details

delete.summary: Delete (deny) a gebruik or koppeling object as afnemer or aanbieder
delete.description: Delete (deny) a gebruik or koppeling object as afnemer or aanbieder.  API Endpoint: DELETE /api/aangeboden-gebruik/{gebruikId}/deny  This endpoint allows deleting a specific gebruik or koppeling object, but only if the active organization is the afnemer (consumer) or aanbieder (provider) for that object. This implements the "deny" workflow where a gemeente can reject a suggestion from a leverancier, or a leverancier can reject/delete their own koppelingen.  Security: Implements custom security checks since RBAC is disabled to access cross-organisation objects. Only the afnemer or aanbieder can delete the object.

200.description: JSON response with success status and deletion details

put.summary: Set the @self property of a gebruik or koppeling to the active organization
put.description: Set the @self property of a gebruik or koppeling to the active organization.  API Endpoint: PUT /api/aangeboden-gebruik/{gebruikId}/set-self  This endpoint allows setting the @self.organisation property of a specific gebruik or koppeling object to the active organization, but only if the active organization is the afnemer (consumer) or aanbieder (provider) for that object.

200.description: JSON response with success status and updated object

post.summary: Import a TOPdesk CMDB export (xlsx) for one municipality
post.description: Nextcloud admins only (not the groups delegated the stackiq admin settings), CSRF-protected (requesttoken header or OCS-APIRequest: true). Creates or updates modules, supplier organisations, usages and owner contact persons, matched on topdesk:<municipality uuid>:<APPID>. See openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-05-cmdb-export-import/contract.md.

413.description: FILE_TOO_LARGE; details.maxBytes is the limit that fired: the profile's maximum, or PHP's upload_max_filesize or post_max_size when lower. WORKBOOK_TOO_LARGE; over a profile limit checked before parsing: the unpacked size of all parts (details.maxUncompressedBytes), of one part the import may parse (details.maxPartBytes, details.part, details.size and, for a sheet, details.sheet; a sheet the import does not read may be larger), the number of shared strings (details.maxSharedStrings), or the shared-string text the cells reference together (details.maxReferencedStringBytes)

500.description: UPLOAD_FAILED (PHP could not store the upload) or IMPORT_FAILED (unexpected; the detail is in the log)

400.description: NO_FILE_UPLOADED, NOT_XLSX, or FIELD_INVALID (updateExisting or publish not true/false/1/0, or a text field sent as an array; details.field names it)

403.description: Not a Nextcloud admin (delegated stackiq admin settings are not enough)

409.description: IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS: another CMDB import holds the register's lock; nothing is read or written

422.description: MISSING_RECORDS_UNSUPPORTED (details.accepted lists keep and archive), MUNICIPALITY_REQUIRED, MUNICIPALITY_INVALID, MUNICIPALITY_AMBIGUOUS (more than one live Municipality has the typed name; details.matches lists their uuids), NO_SOURCE_SHEET, MISSING_COLUMN or TOO_MANY_ROWS

503.description: MAPPING_UNAVAILABLE, READER_UNAVAILABLE, NOT_CONFIGURED, or SCHEMA_OUTDATED (a stackiq schema lacks a property the import matches on, or the module schema predates 0.3.8; details.schema names it and details.missing lists the properties, and externalKey.authorization.update for a missing admin-only write rule), or ARCHIVE_UNAVAILABLE (missingRecords=archive, but OpenRegister's archive handler or object mapper is missing; nothing is read or written)

cmdbFile.description: The TOPdesk export, .xlsx, at most 10 MB

municipalityUuid.description: An existing organization of type Municipality; wins over municipalityName

municipalityName.description: Name of a Municipality to reuse (same normalised name) or create

updateExisting.description: false reports matched rows as skipped (exists). 1 and 0 are accepted too, trimmed and in any case; any other value is refused with 400 FIELD_INVALID

publish.description: true gives every module the import creates a publicationDate (the import's start), so it is public, also to anonymous visitors; false creates them without one, for publication by hand. An update never changes publicationDate either way. 1 and 0 are accepted too, trimmed and in any case; any other value is refused with 400 FIELD_INVALID

missingRecords.description: What happens to the municipality's applications whose APPID is no longer on either CMDB sheet. archive: after the last row, archive module and usage when the sheet "Gearchiveerde Applicaties" lists the APPID, soft-delete them when no sheet does, and archive only when the workbook has no archive sheet, the sheet has no APPID column, an APPID in it has no cached value, or an APPID on a CMDB sheet has no cached value (that application may be the one the reader could not see); an archived or deleted application that returns is unarchived or restored. keep: leave them as they are. mark and remove are reserved and refused with 422 MISSING_RECORDS_UNSUPPORTED

operationId.description: Progress operation id, readable through GET /api/progress/{operationId}. A value that does not match the pattern, or the id of a CMDB import that is still running, is replaced by a generated id; the response's operationId is the id the import used

post.summary: Ask a running CMDB import to stop between rows
post.description: Nextcloud admins only (not the groups delegated the stackiq admin settings), CSRF-protected (requesttoken header or OCS-APIRequest: true). No body.

404.description: OPERATION_NOT_FOUND: no CMDB import with this id is running

500.description: IMPORT_FAILED (unexpected; the exception class and its sanitised first line are in the log)

403.description: Not a Nextcloud admin (delegated stackiq admin settings are not enough)

parameters.name: operationId
parameters.description: The operationId of the import; any other value answers 404 OPERATION_NOT_FOUND

get.description: The display names of the given contact persons.  API Endpoint: GET /api/contact-names?ids[]=<contact person uuid>  Answers `{"names": {"<uuid>": "<display name>"}}`. The per-object check is OpenRegister's: the contact persons are read with the caller's RBAC and organisation scope, so one the caller may not read is left out, as is one whose contact is not in the caller's own or shared address books. At most 120 requests a minute per user (one per list page).

get.description: Get contactpersonen for an organisation with user status.  Authorization (GH#459): the response carries Nextcloud account data, username, full group membership and enabled/disabled state, for every contact of the requested organisation. That is the same payload `getUserInfo()` and `getBulkUserInfo()` refuse to non-admins, so the same bar applies here: an instance admin may read any organisation, anybody else may read only their OWN organisation, and a caller whose organisation cannot be resolved is refused. get.description: Get email configuration only  Admin-only, and the secrets are redacted before they leave the process.  This endpoint used to be @NoAdminRequired and returned getEmailSettings() verbatim, so ANY authenticated user could read the SMTP password and the SendGrid / Mailgun / Postmark / SES / Mailjet API keys in plaintext. Its sibling getEmailSettings() (/api/settings/email) had always done both checks correctly, this one was added later and inherited neither. The redaction is now in SettingsService so the two cannot drift apart again.

Import an SBOM for a `moduleVersie`. Multipart upload only.  `DoesNotExistException` is caught here (not just the explicit `RuntimeException` "moduleVersie not found" guard already inside `SbomImportService::importForModuleVersie()`): OpenRegister's real `ObjectService::find()` does not reliably return `null` for a missing object the way the unit-test stub does, for a well-formed but non-existent uuid its cross-table fallback lookup re-throws `OCP\AppFramework\Db\DoesNotExistException` instead. That exception can originate from `authorizeManage()` (via `SbomImportService::resolveParentModuleUuid()`, for a non-admin/ manage-group caller) or from `importForModuleVersie()` itself, so the whole method body is covered by one outer try/catch rather than threading a guard through each call site individually. Uncaught, this escaped as a 500 (confirmed live for `GET .../sbom` on `getSbomImportStatus()`, the same defect class applies here).

200.description: The import result summary, or a 400/401/403/404/422/500.

get.summary: Read SBOM import status/provenance for a `moduleVersie`, optionally including a `progress-tracking` snapshot when `opera
get.description: Read SBOM import status/provenance for a `moduleVersie`, optionally including a `progress-tracking` snapshot when `operationId` is given.  Confirmed live (500 on a non-existent `moduleVersieUuid`): `SbomImportService::getStatus()` calls OpenRegister's real `ObjectService::find()`, which, despite its `?ObjectEntity` return type suggesting `null` on a miss (and despite the local `if ($moduleVersion !== null)` guard already inside `getStatus()`), can re-throw `OCP\AppFramework\Db\DoesNotExistException` from its cross-table fallback lookup for a well-formed but unresolvable uuid, rather than returning `null`. Uncaught, that propagated straight through this controller method as a 500. Caught here and translated to a proper 404, the endpoint is a plain "read status for this uuid" lookup, so a missing `moduleVersie` is an ordinary not-found, not a server error.

get.summary: The column mapping the CMDB import uses, read-only, with where each pack is edited
get.description: The column mapping the CMDB import uses, read-only, with where each pack is edited.  Loads the import profile and its packs through the loader the import uses (CmdbImportProfile), so the answer is what the next import runs: each sheet pack from OpenRegister's migration-pack store when it holds it, otherwise the shipped file. Success is the flat `{profile, packs, openRegisterPacks}`; every pack carries its source and versions and an `editUrl`, the absolute link to its editor in OpenRegister, or null when it is not stored there. A failure uses the import's error envelope, so the section shows it like an import error, with the loader's reason in `details.reason` because the admin who edited a pack needs to know which pack and why; a pack stored in OpenRegister is also named in `details.pack` and `details.packId`, with `details.editUrl` linking to its editor so the admin can correct it. That reason is the loader's message cut to its first line and REASON_MAX_LENGTH characters: the file or the OpenRegister pack and its id, the broken rule and the configuration value it refused, never a workbook cell or a person.

post.description: Sync OpenRegister organisations to voorzieningen register  Admin-only: this triggers a register-wide write sync with a caller-chosen batch size, so the endpoint must not carry the no-admin-required annotation. Its siblings performSync(), bulkSyncStandards() and triggerEolSync() already omit it, the annotation's absence IS the check on this controller, which is why none of them carries an in-body one.  The annotation is deliberately NOT spelled out above. Nextcloud's own ControllerMethodReflector matches `^\h+\*\h+@([A-Z]\w+)` against the raw docblock, so writing "must not declare @NoAdminRequired" at the start of a comment line RE-DECLARES it, the sentence explaining the removal undoes the removal, in the framework and not merely in a linter. Gate-7 caught it here; nothing else would have.
